ScopeSentence: 授权按 OD04-A 推进三步：①由所有者以管理员身份运行记录人提供的脚本，建立专用运行时目录并设置访问控制；②由记录人编写外层监督程序，审查后绑定其 SHA；③用监督程序做一次只跑清单探测的 T0 演练。不接受资产、不生成 Manifest、不正式运行、不关闭 DSP-004。
CorrectionsToRev23: REV23 MD section 4 and JSON OD04Components overstate T0 and two-side identity as observed; per review they are child-relative observations from an unaccepted, unbound launcher.

REV23 residual list omitted same-user process tampering, token/UAC state, environment and OpenSSL inputs, unchecked loaders, KnownDLLs, trust-on-first-use of the runtime, unsupported script-version claim, post-run SHA binding, and re-serialized records.
REV23 said step 2 bound the supervisor SHA after review; the SHA was first committed after the run (02:16Z vs T0 02:13Z) and the review was self-review.
REV23 *.SANITIZED.json files are re-serialized and cannot be tied to the raw SHAs; byte-redacted copies are added.

RemainingPrepGapRank.Note: RETAIN is recorded. DISPOSE and ELIMINATE are false. The FA-06 register stays NOT_ADMITTED.

OD-05 stays REFUSE_LOCATOR. OD-03 RETAIN does not supply a locator. A new dedicated runtime root now exists on the owner's candidate host (REV23); it is not admitted. OD-05 for AP-006/AP-009 is unchanged.

Independent review (REV24) found one BLOCKING and ten MAJOR issues. The REV23 dry run is a non-evidentiary engineering observation. Qualification needs a pre-bound admin-protected launcher, outside-in module enumeration, PF-004-consistent environment, token/UAC record, post-run scan and verifiable raw records.
KEEP_REV1_RECORD stays the bound choice. The future static identity note is not written.
BLOCK codes stay unrepaired. Actual sequence locators stay null.
Three sides stay UNBOUND. No call to read actual references is authorized.
REV3 SHAs, prior candidate SHAs including 57BAF161, and Harness SHAs are not accepted.
Manifest, formal run, FA-08 and DSP-004 closure stay unauthorized under REV2. Only one inventory-only probe run was authorized.

Checks.Detail: REV23 JSON re-hash equals the SHA cited in the REV23 narrative.
Review verdict NOT_ADMITTED_AS_EVIDENCE with one BLOCKING finding.
